text:
Aisha: Heads up 1: MoonBridge invoice MB-2026-210 is 31 days overdue. Amount $27,450. ACH bounced on 2026-03-15 (code:R02). Do we offer a split-pay option or escalate?
Jon: Sales says they hit a billing reconciliation issue after a contract amendment. They propose 2 payments over 45 days and want us to drop the 1.5% monthly late fee if they pay on schedule.
Priya: They've been a steady mid-market customer. Id be open to a short plan but want controls: require signed ACH mandate and pause automated scale-ups until first payment clears.
Sam: Agree. Proposed schedule: 50% ($13,725) due 2026-04-12, remaining 50% due 2026-05-27. Waive accrued late fees on the condition that Payment 1 clears by 2026-04-12; if Payment 1 fails, immediate suspension and referral to collections.
Aisha: Draft email to customer below for quick sign-off:
"Hi MoonBridge team,

We appreciate the quick call. Per discussion, Redwood Inference will accept the following repayment schedule for invoice MB-2026-210 (total $27,450):
- Payment 1: $13,725 due 2026-04-12 (ACH)
- Payment 2: $13,725 due 2026-05-27 (ACH)

Conditions: 1) First payment must clear by 2026-04-12 or the account will be placed on suspension and standard late fees will apply; 2) Waiver of accrued late fees is conditional on Payment 1 clearing on time; 3) Provisioning and scaling will be restricted until the first payment posts.

Please reply with signed ACH authorization and an estimated date for the first transfer.

Thanks,
Aisha, Finance Ops"

Jon: Customer asked for a 7-point MOU? Keep it short. Can Legal produce a 1-paragraph acknowledgement?
Priya: Legal should draft a one-paragraph MOU that includes the conditional waiver and default remedies. Approve once Legal signs off.
Sam: Collections-bot, please set reminders and auto-escalation triggers.
collections-bot: Reminder scheduled: Payment 1 due 2026-04-12. Escalate to collections if not posted within 4 business days after due date. Automated dunning emails will begin 2026-04-01.
